summaries.title: Video-Panda: Parameter-efficient Alignment for Encoder-free Video-Language Models

Block (STAB) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We present an efficient encoder-free approach for video-language understanding that achieves competitive performance while significantly reducing computational overhead。
